items.text: Hail Survivors,

We're pleased to announce that our second hotfix is now live on Steam and brings a bunch of quality-of-life improvements and balance changes. Thank you to the community for your feedback. All of it helps us improve and enhance Warhammer Survivors, so please keep sharing it with us!

We'd also like to extend a huge thank you to those of you who have recently nominated us in the Steam Awards and left Steam reviews - it really helps us! If you haven't yet, we'll have more details to share on this soon.
Patch notes for Hotfix 2.1.8 can be found further below, but here's a quick look at some of the notable changes:

Balance changes to weapons and enemies, improving weapon damage on select weapons, an aim-assist on the Boltgun and a reduction of max health points on various enemies (including that gargantuan Carnifex!).
Added a health bar for enemy minibosses.
With the introduction of a new grey Skull Gem, enemies will now always provide some amount of XP.
Improved weapon projectile collision on various stages as well as continued improvements to prevent chests dropping at inaccessible locations.
Playable champions now break Light Sources when they walk over them.
Shortened the Treasure Chest animation, and it is now more common to encounter a rare chest if your luck has been poor.
Reduced the volume of the self-destruct alert sound effect.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45845376/7191d8b1af345413efd5a3d77da6c1b26c7c2401.png"]
Hotfix 2.1.8 is now live on Steam, and we will update you when the changes are available on console and mobile platforms.
Enemies
Reduced the max health points of Death Guard enemies and minibosses, including Beasts of Nurgle and Poxwalkers.
Replaced the first miniboss on the Gallowdark stage. Now you’ll need to contend with a mighty Nurgling instead.
Reduced the max health points of some Tyranid enemies, including the Biovore, Carnifex and Zoanthropes.
Reduced the max health points of some Ork enemies.
Replaced the first miniboss on the Ork Stronghold stage. You’ll now face a Boy instead of a Nob.
Enhancements
Increased the effects of the Strength enhancement.
Increased the effects of the Reload enhancement.
Weapons
Increased damage and duration of the Meltagun.
Increased damage and added knockback to Emperor’s Wrath.

Increased damage of the Assault Cannon. In addition, the Assault Cannon’s behaviour has changed. The weapon now fires at the nearest target, then rotates a spray of bullets toward the next closest target.
Increased rate of fire of the Ripper Pistol and the speed of its projectiles.
Added aim-assist behaviour to the Boltgun, allowing it to target nearby enemies in a direction you are facing.
Added aim-assist behaviour to the Fusil Cannon, as well as increasing scale and speed of projectiles.
Made changes to the D6. The explosion and damage of projectiles now scale with the dice face rolled. A ‘1’ doesn’t explode at all (dud!).
Made changes to the Sustained Fire Dice; the damage and explosion size scale depending on the dice face rolled. Unlike the D6, ‘1’s rolled by the Sustained Fire Dice cause damage.
Miscellaneous
Introduced a new grey Skull Gem. Enemies will now always drop a Skull Gem when defeated.
General
Playable characters now break Light Sources when they walk over them.
It is now more common to encounter a rare chest if your luck has been poor.
Shortened the Treasure Chest animation.
Enemies
Added a health bar to enemy minibosses.
Stages
Improved weapon projectile collision across numerous stages.
Increased the size of corridors on the Gallowdark stage.
Removed a collision from small rocks on the Great Parch stage.
Removed an invisible wall from the Deathworld Forest stage.
Continued improvements to prevent chests dropping at inaccessible locations.
UI
Minor updates to various UI screens.
The “Equippable By" field now displays all unlocked characters.
Weapons
Toned down the visual effects of Emperor’s Wrath for better visibility.
It is now possible to shoot over some small walls and barricades.
Miscellaneous

Added a short input delay to the death screen to prevent accidentally rapidly skipping through it. In the same vein, for those with places to be, it is now possible to skip the death animation by pressing any button.
Fixed an issue where abilities triggered by reaching low health would not trigger after redeploying.
Fixed an issue where some Objectives would incorrectly award gold in another Universe when entered for the first time.
Fixed an issue where the Fusil Cannon was useable by ineligible characters.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to change your selected stage after it had been confirmed.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to change your selected character after it had been confirmed.
Fixed numerous audio mixing and volume issues, including reducing the volume of the self-destruct alert sound effect.
Fixed minor text display issues for Simplified and Traditional Chinese languages.
Fixed an issue where, in some cases, a green chest would not evolve a weapon even if the weapon evolution conditions were met.
Mobile only: Fixed an issue where the Warhammer Survivors display would rotate even if autorotating was disabled in the mobile handset’s global settings.

We're aware the hotfixes aren't launching on each platform at the same time. There’s a submission process that can take a few weeks, depending on the platform. Rest assured that we are doing all we can to expedite this. When we have more news to share around hotfix availability, we'll be sure to let the community know.
The Warhammer Survivors Team
Hail Survivors,

It's been incredible to unleash Warhammer Survivors to the world, and we've really appreciated all the comments, reviews, suggestions and feedback you've shared with us in these first 24 hours of launch. Your feedback is important to us as we improve and enhance Warhammer Survivors, so please keep sharing it with us!
The team are hard at work on our free content update that will be coming before the end of the year; however, today we've deployed hotfix v2.1.6 to address a couple of issues.
Steam
Note: the changes in this hotfix will be applied to GOG, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 1 & 2 and mobile platforms from next week.
Patch Notes (Hotfix v2.1.6)
You will now be able to skip the chest sequence by pressing any button.
Tweaked Plague Marine boss variants and Meganobz so that they are not quite as impervious, making them easier to kill.
Reduced the kill count requirements (D6 Dice and Nuln Oil) to unlock the Reikland Fleshshade and Agrax Earthshade Paint Pots.
Fixed an issue where dropped chests would appear in locations where the player could not reach them on the Gallowdark and Imperial Bastion stages.
Fixed an issue where the Legend of Catachan, upon being rescued, would attack with a Chainsword instead of his signature Frag Grenade weapon.
⁠Fixed an issue where the player would be affected by poison clouds created by Mork's Mighty Mushroom long after the poison clouds disappeared.
Fixed an issue where gameplay hints would sometimes fail to appear after being defeated by an Extremis Boss.
The Warhammer Survivors Team
